text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu trying to quell cabinet crisis and finiah a round of new cabinet appointments within two days.
- Israeli paratroop officer killed in South Lebanon.
- Syrian President Hadez al-Assad's assessment: Netanyahu government will survive.
- Foreign Ministry director-general: U.S. State Department is avoiding Israeli diplomats and ignoring them.
- Cabinet reshuffle awaits Foreign Minister David Levy's decision today.
- Communications Minister Limor Livnat to monitor market shares of international call providers.
- Mortar and Katyusha rocket fire along border with Lebanon.
- PLO security official Jibril Rajoub: Undercover Israeli soldiers posing as Arabs who enter our territory will not get out alive.
- Israel trying to keep 10 percent of shares in Bank Hapoalim after privatisation.
